install.note: CLI coding agent by Kilo, forked from OpenCode. The binary is `kilo` (curl installs to ~/.kilo/bin and updates PATH; restart the shell or source the rc file before verifying). Windows: use npm or the GitHub Releases binary. Do NOT install OpenCode's `@opencode/cli` — Kilo Code is a separate product with its own npm package `@kilocode/cli`. For standalone CLI updates, use `kilo upgrade` or `npm update -g @kilocode/cli`; Kilo Desktop updates its bundled CLI through the Desktop update lifecycle.

blocked_regions.zh-CN: kilo.ai is reachable in mainland China, but the curl installer downloads the binary from GitHub Releases, which is unreliable there. If the curl install stalls or fails, use npm instead: `npm install -g @kilocode/cli --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com`.

first_run.description: Run `kilo auth login` and select Kilo for browser account login, or run /connect in the TUI. Use `kilo auth list` to verify connected providers. Kilo Desktop uses the same Gateway credential store, with separate Desktop model preferences. Custom OpenAI-compatible providers remain supported.
